CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayMax

Returns the largest value in a one-dimensional array of numbers.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayMax(array)

Parameters

array
A one-dimensional array of numeric values.

Returns

The largest element as a number; 0 for an empty array.

Usage

The comparison is numeric, so "10" is larger than "9". A non-numeric element throws an Expression exception. For the smallest value, use ArrayMin.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Scores = ListToArray("4200,15750,980,8800")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Pinball scores: #ArrayToList(Scores, ", ")#</P>
<P>High score: <B>#NumberFormat(ArrayMax(Scores), ",")#</B><BR>
Low score: #NumberFormat(ArrayMin(Scores), ",")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayMin, ArrayAvg, ArraySum, Max
